cohort: Singleton pregnant women with a short cervix (CL <= 2.5 cm) diagnosed at 18 to 24 weeks' gestation who were receiving progesterone treatment.
finding: After two weeks of progesterone treatment, women who had sPTB showed significantly higher levels of ECI, IOS, and EOS, and lower hardness ratio, with IOS and EOS associated with a 3.38-fold and 2.29-fold increased risk of sPTB before 37 weeks, respectively.
gest_age: 18 to 24 weeks at enrollment; sPTB defined as birth before 37 weeks
